card.name: Patients who received placebo or drug
card.fires_on: The word "who" (or a group noun like patients, subjects, women) right after a count or percentage of trial participants, just before a verb like received or assigned.

modes.label: who after trial group
modes.description: "who" follows patients or subjects in an event-rate comparison, leading into "received".
modes.example: 2% of patients<< who>> received placebo. No cognitive dysfunction-related events

modes.label: group noun before assignment
modes.description: A group noun such as patients, subjects or women is marked where the next words say what they were assigned or given.

card.writes: It favors a following verb like "received" or "sign(ed)" that says which treatment the group was given.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a trial report is about to say what treatment a group of participants received.
